prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1242; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is pursuing a claim for compensation.

Effective immediately, please direct all communication regarding this matter to this office. Please do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person. Any inquiries should be routed through our office.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits for the insured driver and any applicable excess or umbrella coverage. Please also confirm the policy number, the coverage period, and the identity of any other insurers that may provide coverage for this loss.

We further demand that you preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, telematics or dashcam data, vehicle event data, repair records, and any other materials in your possession or control. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in sanctions.
